40          THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

[Photograph: Reproduction of a catalog page. Text reads:

Having our claims as set out[?] as shown in the past, we would ask the patronage and support of all friends of liberal education everywhere. We point with pride to the many strong teachers, doctors and preachers, who have been prepared in our school, and its prosperous increase in many parts of the state.

APPARATUS.

A sufficient supply of necessary electrical and philosophical apparatus procured from [?], to meet all the demands of the students.

Moral Influences.

We, the College, do strictly and unmistakably tell, it is the constant aim of the faculty to maintain around this locality strong moral influence, both by precept and example.

We have a fine Sunday school connected with our institution, and all those who do not attend any church are expected, while on[?] under the privileges of attending the church of this institution.

- - -
